targets.rawSql:
WITH
latest_export AS (
  SELECT source_key, status, started_at, error_message
  FROM   heart360tk_reporting.export_run_log
  ORDER  BY started_at DESC
  LIMIT  1
),
latest_success AS (
  SELECT started_at
  FROM   heart360tk_reporting.export_run_log
  WHERE  status = 'success'
  ORDER  BY started_at DESC
  LIMIT  1
),
ago AS (
  -- Write the time-ago CASE exactly once; apply it to both timestamps.
  SELECT
    ts_name,
    CASE
      WHEN ts IS NULL                               THEN '—'
      WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - ts) <    60  THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - ts)::int || 's ago'
      WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - ts) <  3600  THEN (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - ts) /   60)::int || ' min ago'
      WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - ts) < 86400  THEN (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - ts) / 3600)::int || ' hours ago'
      ELSE                                               (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - ts) / 86400)::int || ' days ago'
    END AS ago_text
  FROM (VALUES
    ('attempt', (SELECT started_at FROM latest_export)),
    ('success', (SELECT started_at FROM latest_success))
  ) t(ts_name, ts)
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(le.source_key, '')                                  AS source_key,
  COALESCE(le.status, '')                                      AS last_status,
  (SELECT ago_text FROM ago WHERE ts_name = 'attempt')         AS last_attempt_ago,
  (SELECT ago_text FROM ago WHERE ts_name = 'success')         AS last_success_ago,
  CASE
    WHEN le.error_message IS NULL
      THEN ''
    WHEN le.error_message ~* 'sftp.*login|ssh.*auth|authentication.*fail|wrong.*password|bad.*password'
      THEN 'SFTP login was rejected by the central node. The stored credentials for this facility may have expired — check the SFTP username and password in the export config and try again.'
    WHEN le.error_message ~* 'connection.*refused|timed.?out|network.*unreachable|no.*route'
      THEN 'Could not connect to the central node. Check that the SFTP host address and port are correct, and that the network is reachable.'
    WHEN le.error_message ~* 'no such file|directory.*not.*found'
      THEN 'The export destination folder does not exist on the central node. Check the SFTP remote path in the export config.'
    WHEN le.error_message ~* 'permission.*denied|access.*denied'
      THEN 'The export user does not have permission to write to the destination folder. Check SFTP user permissions on the central node.'
    WHEN le.error_message ~* 'disk.*full|no space|quota.*exceeded'
      THEN 'The central node is out of disk space. Free up space or contact your system administrator.'
    ELSE le.error_message
  END AS friendly_error
FROM  (SELECT 1) base
LEFT  JOIN latest_export le ON true
WHERE $UserIsAdmin = 1

WITH period AS (
  SELECT
    TO_CHAR(started_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS started_at,
    status,
    ROUND(COALESCE(duration_seconds, 0)::numeric, 1)                       AS duration_seconds,
    started_at                                                              AS raw_at
  FROM heart360tk_reporting.export_run_log
  WHERE started_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamp AND $__timeTo()::timestamp
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    json_agg(
      json_build_object(
        'started_at',       started_at,
        'status',           status,
        'duration_seconds', duration_seconds
      )
      ORDER BY raw_at
    )::text                                   AS runs_json,
    ROUND(AVG(duration_seconds)::numeric, 1)  AS avg_duration,
    ROUND(MAX(duration_seconds)::numeric, 1)  AS max_duration
  FROM period
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(a.runs_json,    '[]') AS runs_json,
  COALESCE(a.avg_duration, 0)    AS avg_duration,
  COALESCE(a.max_duration, 0)    AS max_duration
FROM  (SELECT 1) base
LEFT  JOIN agg a ON true
WHERE $UserIsAdmin = 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(t) ORDER BY t.started_at DESC) FROM (SELECT started_at, TO_CHAR(started_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'DD Mon HH24:MI') AS attempt_time, status, COALESCE(duration_seconds::text || 's', '—') AS duration, CASE WHEN error_message IS NULL THEN '—' WHEN error_message ~* 'sftp.*login|authentication.*fail|wrong.*password|bad.*password|ssh.*auth' THEN 'SFTP login rejected — check credentials' WHEN error_message ~* 'connection.*refused|timed.?out|network.*unreachable|no.*route' THEN 'Connection failed — check network' WHEN error_message ~* 'no such file|directory.*not.*found' THEN 'Remote path not found' WHEN error_message ~* 'permission.*denied|access.*denied' THEN 'Permission denied — check SFTP access' WHEN error_message ~* 'disk.*full|no space|quota.*exceeded' THEN 'Disk full on central node' ELSE COALESCE(LEFT(error_message, 80), '—') END AS failure_reason FROM heart360tk_reporting.export_run_log ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 200) t), '[]'::json)::text AS rows_json FROM (SELECT 1) base WHERE $UserIsAdmin = 1
